over_ons.hero_subtitle: Discover the story behind Hulpdienstvoertuigen BeNeLux
over_ons.about_p1: This website was created because there was no central collection point for all emergency services vehicles from Belgium and the Netherlands. The initiators are several players of Meldkamerspel. They noticed it was difficult to find the right vehicles, correct call signs, and exact locations.
over_ons.about_p2: About two years ago, we started collecting vehicle data and locations from approximately 16 different disciplines. This was quite a task. All found information is processed into an overview. The overview is a living project, meaning we regularly add new data and update existing information.
over_ons.about_p3: Our goal is to create the most complete and up-to-date database of emergency services vehicles in the Benelux, accessible to anyone interested in emergency services, from hobbyists to professionals.
over_ons.faq_q1: Which countries are featured on the site?
over_ons.faq_a1: The Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg. You can find more information about each country on the website.
over_ons.faq_q2: Can I use photos from the website?
over_ons.faq_a2: That depends on the license and permission of the photographer. Always contact the photographer first.
over_ons.faq_q3: Can I submit my own photos?
over_ons.faq_a3: Yes, visitors can also submit photos. Make sure your photos do not contain privacy-sensitive information. You can submit photos here.
over_ons.faq_a4: No, not always. Photos are reviewed for quality, relevance, and safety.
over_ons.faq_q5: How is the vehicle information collected?
over_ons.faq_a5: Through open sources, spotters, official press releases, and the emergency services themselves. Together with contributions from visitors.
over_ons.faq_q6: Can I report an error in the information?
over_ons.faq_a6: Yes, you can. Submit a form here or create a ticket in our Discord server.
over_ons.faq_a7: You can contact us here or create a ticket in our Discord server.
over_ons.faq_q8: Can I collaborate or become a partner?
over_ons.faq_a8: Yes, you can. If you are interested, please contact one of the administrators or create a ticket in our Discord server.

privacy.meta_description: Read how HulpdienstvoertuigenBenelux handles your personal data. Discover what data we collect (Discord, photo uploads, analytics), why and for how long we keep it, and what your rights are under the GDPR.

privacy.s1_p1: HulpdienstvoertuigenBeNeLux (hereafter: "we", "us" or "our") collects photos and information about emergency service vehicles from the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg and displays these publicly to visitors. In this privacy policy we explain which personal data we process, why we do this, on what legal basis and how we protect your data.
privacy.s1_p2: We process personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Dutch GDPR Implementation Act. By using our website and services, you declare that you have taken note of this policy.
privacy.s1_p3: Controller: HulpdienstvoertuigenBeNeLux is responsible for the processing of personal data as described in this privacy policy.
privacy.s1_note: Important to know: this website is a public photo database. Submitted photos and vehicle data become publicly visible to all visitors after approval.
privacy.s2_title: What personal data do we collect?
privacy.s2_p1: Depending on how you use our website, we process the following data:
privacy.s2_data1_text: Discord ID, username, global name and avatar. Only when you log in or submit a photo.
privacy.s2_data2_text: Your submitted photo. Optionally a copyright name for the watermark.
privacy.s2_data3_text: Name, email address, reason and the content of your message.
privacy.s2_data4_text: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and click behaviour (via Matomo and Google Analytics, only after consent).
privacy.s2_data5_text: Donation data provided via TipeeeStream (name, amount, message). Donations are shown publicly on our website; upon your request we hide or delete your donation.
privacy.s2_p2: We do not collect special categories of personal data (such as health, religion or ethnicity), unless you provide these yourself in a free-text field. We therefore ask you not to provide special categories of personal data or other sensitive information through free-text fields when this is not necessary.
privacy.s2_p3: Our services are not specifically aimed at children. We ask people under the age of 16 not to create an account or provide personal data via our website without the consent of their parent or legal guardian.
privacy.s3_p1: We process your personal data exclusively for the following purposes, with the associated legal basis from Article 6 GDPR:
privacy.s3_li1: Operation and security of the website — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li2: Account linking via Discord login and linking submissions to your profile — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li3: Public display of submitted photos — consent when submitting and our legitimate interest as a photo database (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li4: Handling of contact requests — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li5: Analysis and improvement of the website — for non-essential cookies based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li6: Processing of donations (payment via TipeeeStream) — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s3_li7: Public display of donations — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); you can object to this, after which we will hide or delete your donation.
privacy.s3_li8: Compliance with legal obligations (e.g. retention obligations, supervisory authorities) — legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacy.s3_p2: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling that has legal consequences for you.
privacy.s4_p1: We never sell your personal data to third parties. For the operation of our website we use external service providers and platforms. Depending on the nature of the processing, these parties may act as processor, independent controller or joint controller:
privacy.s4_li1: Discord Inc. (US) — authentication via OAuth and displaying avatars. For transfers to the US we use an applicable legal transfer basis, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.s4_li2: GitHub, Inc. (US) — storage and publication of the submitted images in public repositories. Approved images may therefore also be accessible directly outside our website. An applicable legal transfer basis applies for transfers to the US.
privacy.s4_li3: Google LLC (US) — Google Analytics 4 for statistical analysis, only after your consent. Google may process personal data and transfer data to countries outside the EEA. An applicable legal transfer basis is used for such transfers.
privacy.s4_li4: Matomo — self-hosted statistics on our own server; no transfer to third parties takes place.
privacy.s4_li6: Hosting and email providers — hosting of the website and sending contact emails.
privacy.s4_p2: Where these parties act as our processor, we conclude appropriate processing agreements. For transfers of data to countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), we use approved EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), adequacy decisions of the European Commission (such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework) or other valid transfer mechanisms.
privacy.s4_p3: Furthermore, we may provide data to competent authorities if we are legally obliged to do so (for example, following a court order or a request from the Dutch Data Protection Authority).
privacy.s4_note: Transfer outside the EEA only takes place with appropriate safeguards, as described in Chapter V of the GDPR.
privacy.s5_public_text: After approval, your photo and the associated vehicle data are shown publicly on the website (including map, lists and photo carousel). This is the core purpose of our database. Keep this in mind before submitting a photo.
privacy.s5_li_watermark: If you provide a copyright name, it is placed as a watermark ( name) on the image.
privacy.s5_license_text: By submitting a photo you grant HulpdienstvoertuigenBeNeLux a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to process, technically adjust, store and publicly display the photo through our website and associated channels, insofar as necessary for the purpose of the database. You remain the owner of the copyright.
privacy.s5_responsibility_text: Users who upload photos are themselves fully responsible for ensuring that they have the necessary rights. By uploading, you declare that you are the rights holder of the image, or that you have the explicit permission of the rights holder. You indemnify HulpdienstvoertuigenBeNeLux against all claims by third parties relating to copyright infringements.
privacy.s5_warning: Important: Uploading copyrighted material without permission is not allowed. Unlawful uploads may lead to removal of the photo and/or blocking of your account.
privacy.s5_notice_text: Are you the rights holder of an image that has been placed on our website without your permission? You can then submit a removal request. We will confirm receipt within 2 business days and remove the relevant image(s) as soon as possible for justified requests, within 5 business days at the latest after receipt of a valid request.
privacy.s5_valid_li1: Your full name and contact details (email address, preferably also phone number).
privacy.s5_valid_li2: A clear description of the image(s) you want removed (preferably with the direct URL/link to the page where the image appears).
privacy.s5_valid_li3: A statement explaining why you believe the image infringes your copyright.
privacy.s5_valid_li4: Preferably proof of your authorship (e.g. a link to the original publication, a metadata screenshot or a description of how you took the photo).
privacy.s5_after_li1: We will confirm receipt of your request within 2 business days.
privacy.s5_after_li2: We will assess your request and remove the image(s) if your claim is justified.
privacy.s5_after_li3: In case of doubt, we may ask for additional information.
privacy.s5_note: Note: Submitting a false or misleading removal request may have legal consequences. Only submit a request if you are actually the rights holder.
privacy.s6_p1: Our website uses functional and analytical cookies:
privacy.s6_li1: Functional (essential) cookies: always active and necessary for the functioning of the website, for example remembering your login status and cookie preferences.
privacy.s6_li2: Analytical cookies: only after your consent via our cookie banner. We use Matomo (self-hosted on our own server, first-party) and Google Analytics (only after your consent).
privacy.s6_p2: You can refuse, withdraw or adjust cookies at any time via the cookie banner or your browser settings. For more details, we refer to our cookie policy.
privacy.s6_note: If you disable cookies, the website will generally still work, but some (non-essential) features may not function optimally.
privacy.s7_p1: We do not keep personal data longer than necessary for the purposes for which they were collected. Our retention periods are:
privacy.s7_li1: Discord account link and profile data: for as long as your account is active and your submissions exist; deleted upon your request.
privacy.s7_li2: Submitted photos and vehicle data: rejected submissions are automatically deleted after 7 days; approved photos remain until they are deleted at your request or by a valid removal request.
privacy.s7_li3: Contact form: is only sent by email and not stored in our database; emails are kept until the case is handled, for a maximum of 1 year, and then cleaned up.
privacy.s7_li4: Analytics data: stored via our analytics tools (Matomo and Google Analytics) with anonymised IP addresses and without linking to your identity.
privacy.s7_li5: Server logs (IP addresses, visits): kept no longer than necessary for security, debugging and management of the website.
privacy.s7_li6: Donation data: kept without a fixed term for administrative and legal obligations (including the fiscal retention obligation).
privacy.s7_p2: Upon a deletion request, we delete your Discord link, username and avatar and unlink your submissions from your profile. Some of this data may temporarily remain due to backups or security; this is cleaned up as soon as possible.
privacy.s7_p3: After the expiry of the period, data is deleted or anonymised, unless legal retention obligations (such as the fiscal retention obligation) require a longer period.
privacy.s8_p1: Under the GDPR you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.s8_right1_text: Know which data we process about you and why.
privacy.s8_right2_text: Have incorrect or incomplete data corrected.
privacy.s8_right3_text: Have data deleted, unless a legal exception applies.
privacy.s8_right5_text: Receive and transfer your data in a structured, commonly used format, insofar as the legal conditions apply.
privacy.s8_right6_text: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
privacy.s8_p2: In addition, you have the right to withdraw consent that you previously gave (for example for analytical cookies), without affecting the lawfulness of the processing before the withdrawal.
privacy.s8_p3: Want to exercise one of these rights? Contact us via the details under Contact details. We will respond as soon as possible and in principle within one month to your request. If a request is complex or if we receive multiple requests, this period may be extended by up to two months under the conditions of the GDPR; we will inform you about this within one month. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
privacy.s8_warning: Note: A request to remove your photo or data from public pages also means that the relevant image(s) are removed from the website (and the image repositories used). Because images are stored in public GitHub repositories, copies may remain temporarily accessible via git history, forks, caches or the GitHub CDN; we cannot guarantee their complete removal. Approved and published photos cannot simply be "hidden" in the database.
privacy.s9_p1: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against loss, theft or unlawful processing:
privacy.s9_li1: Encrypted connections (HTTPS / SSL) for all pages and API traffic.
privacy.s9_li2: Restricted access to servers, databases and management environments on a "need to know" basis.
privacy.s9_li3: No storage of passwords in readable form; where necessary we use hashed values.
privacy.s9_li4: Regular software updates and active monitoring of security risks.
privacy.s9_li5: Data minimisation: we only collect data that we actually need.
privacy.s9_p2: If there is a notifiable data breach, we report it within the legal deadline to the Dutch Data Protection Authority and inform affected parties if the GDPR requires this.
privacy.s10_p1: For questions or comments about this privacy policy, about the processing of your personal data, or for a removal request (copyright), you can contact us via:
privacy.s10_p2: We aim to answer your question within 5 business days.
privacy.s10_note: This privacy policy may be changed from time to time, for example due to changes in legislation, our services or processors. The most current version is always on this page. We recommend that you check this policy regularly.

cookiebeleid.s1_p1: Our website HulpdienstvoertuigenBeNeLux uses cookies and similar technologies. This cookie policy explains which cookies these are, why we use them and how you can set your preferences. We respect your privacy and strive for transparency.
cookiebeleid.s1_p2: On this site we use only two analytics solutions: Google Analytics (configured privacy-friendly) and Matomo (our own, self-hosted analytics service). In addition, functional cookies are placed that are necessary for the functioning of the website. No advertising, marketing or social media cookies are used.
cookiebeleid.s1_p3: For a full overview of how we handle personal data, we refer to our privacy policy.
cookiebeleid.s1_note: Your visit is only analysed to improve the site. We do not sell data and do not use advertising cookies.
cookiebeleid.s2_p1: Cookies are small text files placed by a website on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone). They contain information that can be read later. This way we can, for example, track which pages you visit, whether you have been to the site before, and ensure that functionalities (such as logging in) work.
cookiebeleid.s2_p2: There are first-party cookies (from our own site) and third-party cookies (from external services). In our case, Google Analytics and Matomo are treated as first-party cookies, because we have configured them ourselves: Matomo is self-hosted and Google Analytics is loaded with privacy settings. In addition, the site uses localStorage to remember your cookie preference; this is also first-party storage on your own device.
cookiebeleid.s2_p3: Note: the fonts (Nunito) and icons (Font Awesome) we use are served locally by our own server and therefore do not place any cookies or other third-party tracking.
cookiebeleid.s3_p1: We distinguish three types of cookies. Only functional cookies are strictly necessary. Analytics (Google Analytics and Matomo) are only activated after your consent via the cookie notice.
cookiebeleid.c1_name: Functional cookies (e.g. login status, language, cookie preference)
cookiebeleid.s3_p2: No third-party tracking cookies are used in our carousels and UI components. We therefore do not place any cookies from social media or advertising networks either.
cookiebeleid.s4_p1: We use Google Analytics 4 to gain insight into the use of our website. Google Analytics is a web analytics service of Google LLC (US). We have configured Google Analytics to be privacy-friendly:
cookiebeleid.s4_li1: IP addresses are anonymised before they are processed.
cookiebeleid.s4_li2: Google signals and advertising personalisation are disabled.
cookiebeleid.s4_li3: A processing agreement has been concluded with Google.
cookiebeleid.s4_li4: Google only receives data for providing the analytics reports and may not use it for other Google services.
cookiebeleid.s4_p2: The collected data may be transferred to and stored by Google on servers in the United States. Google is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF), ensuring an adequate level of protection. More information: Google's privacy policy.
cookiebeleid.s4_p3: Disable Google Analytics: via Google's official browser add-on, or via your cookie preferences below.
cookiebeleid.s5_p1: In addition to Google Analytics, we use Matomo, an open-source web analytics platform that we host on our own servers (via hulpdienstvoertuigenbenelux.nl/piwikstats). This keeps all visitor data within our management environment and it is not shared with third parties. Matomo is configured with respect for your privacy:
cookiebeleid.s5_li1: No transfer of personal data to countries outside the EEA.
cookiebeleid.s5_li2: IP addresses are anonymised before they are stored (last bytes removed).
cookiebeleid.s5_li3: Matomo waits for your consent before data is collected.
cookiebeleid.s5_li4: Cookies have a limited lifespan (13 months for recognition, 30 minutes for sessions).
cookiebeleid.s5_p2: Matomo helps us understand which pages are popular, how visitors navigate and where we can improve the user experience. Because Matomo is self-hosted, no processor outside our organisation is involved.
cookiebeleid.s6_p1: You always have the right to refuse, withdraw or delete cookies. You can adjust your preferences in the cookie notice, via the buttons below or via the settings of your browser.
cookiebeleid.s6_p2: Browser settings: In most browsers you can accept, refuse or delete cookies (e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari). Please note that without functional cookies, some parts of the website may not work optimally.
